cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Stay Until I’m Steady
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until you feel steady enough to face what comes next without them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Stay for tea. I need to tell the children about tomorrow's operation without crying.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then skip the kettle. Let me practise telling you before I fetch them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask for two minutes. Let me say 'I'll be in hospital' without apologising to you. Then I'll try telling them myself.
